Theorem
[Long time existence---closed manifolds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0385 ↗ thm:chow-ii-appd-short-time-existence-closed 1. appD:D.4\group Ricci Flow Existence

The Ricci flow from a smooth metric on a closed manifold has a unique maximal solution on $[0,T)$, where $T\leq \infty $. If $T<\infty $, then \[ \lim _{t\nearrow T}\sup _{x\in \mathcal M}|\operatorname {Rm}(x,t)|=\infty . \]
